items.title: Francophonie summit postpones new leader vote amid DR Congo-Rwanda dispute
items.desc: The Organisation Internationale de la Francophonie (OIF) on Monday had been set to choose its new secretary general during talks in the Cambodian capital Phnom Penh. But delegates decided to postpone the election for a year after a walkout threat by the Democratic Republic of Congo amid an ongoing dispute between Kinshasa and Kigali.

items.title: Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran oo soo bandhigay "magaalo dhulka hoostiisa ku taalla oo ay Gantaallo ku keydsan yihiin"
items.desc: Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran ayaa Talaadadii, 9-kii Nofeembar, baahisay sawirro ay ku sheegtay inay muujinayaan "magaalo cusub oo dhulka hoostiisa ah oo gantaallada lagu keydiyo" oo ay leeyihiin ciidamada cirka iyo hawada sare ee Ilaalada Kacaanka.

items.title: Germany news: Merz, Söder aim to revisit electricity tax cut
items.desc: The Christian Democrats are in Munich, pushing to revive some tax relief that didn't make it into the budget after talks last week. And Manuela Schwesig faces a vote on a new term as regional leader. Follow DW.
